scope: audited scientific-ref README ownership, claim ceiling, next question, repository status and non-scientific staging boundary
display_rule: one active scientific repository = one visible fragment; repository existence alone does not create a scientific fragment

tracking.movement: Live public GitHub repository metadata. pushed_at marks repository motion, not scientific revision.
tracking.scientific_ref_detail: Repositories are audited on the default branch unless an explicit scientific_ref is declared. SCH currently uses its active PR head because main is a placeholder.
tracking.claim_drift: README drift is an audit signal, not an automatic scientific reinterpretation.

status_semantics.result: the current scientific core is closed; negative and conditional results count
status_semantics.bounded: a repository-owned result exists with explicit external, empirical or transfer limits
status_semantics.open: a prospectively frozen or explicitly staged scientific gate remains unresolved
status_semantics.stop: retired or superseded; not an active fragment
status_semantics.staging: repository exists but does not yet own an independent scientific question/inferential contract; this is not a scientific status

active.role: own-data discrimination after the public-data evolutionary-history ceiling
multidimensional niche geometry; vertical chain closed, independent Snapshot Serengeti temporal-partition gate prospectively open

staging.promotion_gate: declare an independent scientific question, inherited v2.8.4 boundary, evidence contract, claim ceiling and terminal outcomes; otherwise remain staging or move work back into SDMR

superseded_components.current_repository_scope: multidimensional niche geometry: vertical/temporal/structural added axes, partition and held-out transferability
superseded_components.reason: the repository name was reactivated for a new Chapter-2 scope; the old topology ownership remains with EOG
Paper A identification-boundary theory and Paper B observation-design methodology now have separate repositories

azami_three_chapter.spine: present phenotypic breadth -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination
azami_three_chapter.rule: Chapter 3 discriminates histories left compatible by Chapter 2; future own data do not retroactively confirm the public-data chapter

niche_to_survey.rule: epistemic chapter order != software dependency or transferred claim ownership

record_entry_and_semantics.rule: pre-entry record selection != post-entry semantic coarsening; development lineage and information flow point in opposite directions

philosophy.title: PhD in zuizui
philosophy.sentence: Not ownership of answers, but responsibility for what is retained, constrained, safely forgotten, and left revisable.
axioms: same colour is not the same state
an island is not one response
no record is not no event
a shared cue is not one-way attraction
mechanistic proximity is not identification strength
